name: Planet Pay payments
author: planetpaypayment

sections.description:
Planet Pay integrates WooCommerce with the Planet Pay payment gateway.

Supports card payments, BLIK, Google Pay, Apple Pay, and Pay-By-Link (Transfer Online).
Works with both classic and block WooCommerce checkout.

Payment methods

  • Card — redirect to Planet Pay paywall
  • BLIK Zero — customer enters the 6-digit code directly on the checkout page (inline, with polling)
  • BLIK Standard — redirect to Planet Pay gateway
  • Apple Pay Express — one-tap payment directly on checkout
  • Apple Pay Paywall — redirect to Planet Pay gateway
  • Google Pay — redirect to Planet Pay paywall
  • Pay-By-Link (Transfer Online) — redirect to Planet Pay paywall

Features

  • Full support for WooCommerce block checkout
  • Refund flow with dedicated order statuses (Requested / Approved / Rejected)
  • Email notifications for merchants and customers on refund events
  • Built-in API connection test (production and sandbox)
  • Payment method synchronization from Planet Pay gateway
  • Apple Pay domain verification
  • Payment retry for expired orders
  • Pay-again email links

External services

This plugin communicates with the PlanetPay API to process online payments.

  • Sandbox URL: https://api.sandbox.planetpay.pl/v1/ecommerce
  • Production URL: https://api.planetpay.pl/v1/ecommerce
  • Terms of Service: PlanetPay Terms

Data sent to the API includes: order ID, transaction amount, customer data, merchant credentials, BLIK code (for BLIK zero payments), Apple Pay token (for Apple Pay express), and refund details.

Data is sent when: initiating a payment, checking payment status (BLIK polling), requesting a refund, and receiving asynchronous notifications.

Security

Security bugs can be reported via the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program.

Report a vulnerability

License

GPLv2 or later — https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. In WordPress admin go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the ZIP and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin in Plugins > Installed Plugins.
  5. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments > Planet Pay and configure your credentials.
sections.faq:
What WooCommerce versions are supported?

WooCommerce 6.5 or higher.

What PHP version is required?

PHP 7.4+ with extensions: ext-curl, ext-json, ext-sodium.

Does the plugin support the WooCommerce block checkout?

Yes — the plugin fully supports both classic and block checkout.

What payment methods are available?

Card, BLIK (zero and standard mode), Google Pay, Apple Pay (express and paywall mode), and Pay-By-Link (Transfer Online).

How do refunds work?

Refunds are processed via the Planet Pay gateway. After requesting a refund the order status changes to Refund Requested. Planet Pay processes it asynchronously and updates the status to Refund Approved or Refund Rejected. Email notifications are sent automatically.
sections.changelog:
5.4.10

  • Fix: The “complete the payment” e-mail is no longer sent when payment renewal is disabled – new “Enable payment renewal” setting (off by default) controls the e-mail, the “Complete the payment” button and the payment link

5.4.9

  • Security: Restored 5.4.8 security fixes lost in a branch merge (ownership checks, 302 return redirect, amount verification)
  • Security: Apple Pay merchant validation endpoint requires a valid REST nonce and is rate limited
  • Security: Amount verification reads order.amount from the payment details response
  • Security: BLIK status check completes the order via payment_complete() with amount verification
  • Fix: Auto-cancel time limit counts from the latest payment attempt, not the order creation
  • Fix: Pay again link enforces the time limit immediately – expired orders are cancelled instead of opening the paywall
  • Fix: Pay again no longer retries a payment that is still open on the Planet Pay side
  • Fix: Pay again errors redirect to the order received page and the notice is shown to guests too
  • Fix: Pay again link for an already paid order shows a “payment already completed” notice
  • Fix: Pay again e-mail link opens a confirmation page – e-mail link scanners no longer start a payment
  • Fix: Return page no longer fails with “Order not found” for shop staff or a different logged-in account

5.4.8

  • Security: Apple Pay merchant validation endpoint requires valid REST nonce or logged-in user
  • Security: BLIK status check and success page verify order ownership for logged-in users
  • Security: Payment completion verifies gateway-reported amount against order total
  • Security: Success page redirect changed from 301 to 302
  • Cleanup: Removed unused BLIK checkout processor classes

5.4.7

  • Fix: Relax billing data requirements for virtual product orders

5.4.6

  • Security: Apple Pay express checkout no longer passes client-supplied checkout data to order creation
  • Security: Removed unused BLIK AJAX endpoint and BLIK checkout processors
  • Security: Removed unused Apple Pay shipping handling that trusted client-supplied prices
  • Security: BLIK payment status check now requires a valid order key
  • Security: Apple Pay express checkout uses its own dedicated nonce

5.4.5

  • Feature: Apple Pay Check Connection button in express checkout settings

5.4.4

  • Security: Restrict BLIK payment AJAX endpoint to authenticated users only
  • Security: Sanitize checkout data with a denylist to prevent order takeover
  • Security: Use server-side shipping rates in Block Checkout
  • Security: Replace PHP session with WooCommerce session for pending order tracking

5.4.3

  • Fix: Unknown payment method label on payment retry
